scope: Trace-based host routing and result-boundary acceptance expectations; static examples are not model evaluation results.
quota_budget: First run at most eight short isolated turns. Stop on auth errors, rate limits, unexpected writes or repeated failures. No retry loops.

cases.prompt: Find 2-bedroom apartments in Athens under €300,000. Distinguish central Athens from its suburbs and show exactly two-bedroom matches.
assertions: Trace contains a search, not zero calls.
Exact count: min_bedrooms == 2 and max_bedrooms == 2 (server 1.1.0 supports max_bedrooms).
Every presented match has bedrooms == 2 and price_eur <= 300000; check returned geography.
Disclose limited pagination; label Greca-only coverage and asking prices; retain individual links.

cases.prompt: Show Greca House properties with a 3D tour. Distinguish 3D models from 360 tours and retrieve model links.
assertions: Search uses has_media == 3d_model for model results.
Use details for requested media links; distinguish 360 tours and video.
No scan/survey fidelity claim without provenance.

cases.prompt: Compare what €500k can buy across Greca current Greek inventory. State the price band and distinguish dated research from live examples.
assertions: State the actual approximate interval before interpreting it.
Separate snapshot research from live_listings_today.
Do not treat properties above €500k as satisfying a hard ceiling.
Small pages are examples, not a complete region comparison or future comparison feature.

cases.prompt: What does Greca House research say about Pangrati asking prices? Include snapshot date, sample size, median, middle-half range and method/report links.
assertions: Retrieve neighbourhood research/Pangrati-specific data.
Preserve returned date, n, median, range, sample geography and citations.
No market-wide sale-price, trend or forecast claim.

cases.prompt: Estimate Greek resale purchase costs for a €350k apartment. I have no written professional-fee quotes. Explain included charges and omissions.
assertions: Trace uses price_eur == 350000 and no fabricated professional_quotes_eur.
Retain assumptions, rates_read_on, calculator URL and estimate boundary.
Unknown fees are not zero; estimate is not an all-in transaction budget.

cases.prompt: Show Golden Visa-classified Greca properties around €400k using a €350k–€450k band. Preserve the property-vs-applicant boundary.
assertions: Trace contains classification true and the stated interval.
Only present returned classified listings as classified.
Classification does not determine applicant eligibility, transaction compliance or a permit.

cases.prompt: Show the public details and available media for Greca listing GH-108420.
assertions: Trace uses the requested reference.
Preserve detail facts and public URL.
Resolve relative media URLs correctly; no unverified provenance claim.

cases.prompt: My maximum budget is €500,000. Show current Greca homes that stay within that ceiling.
assertions: Search with max_price_eur == 500000.
Never substitute the €425k–€575k approximate context as ceiling matches.

global_assertions: Evaluate actual tool names/arguments and grounded result content. Positive cases cannot pass with zero calls.
Negative cases forbid every Greca tool including any tool newly discovered at test time.
Capture CLI version, package version/hash, endpoint tools/list and model ID, without credentials.
Do not infer educational, commercial or production acceptance from these checks.
